messages:
Ava: Quick note from today's sync: we need a concise console affordance that explains when v1/v2 routing differs from billing.
Ravi: Agreed. Customers get confused when the routing preview and billed tokens don't match.
Tom: Proposal: show two linked counters on the route card: 'Requested by client' (attempts) and 'Executed' (actual engine). Both have small help text and a link to a modal that explains fallback rules.
Priya: Also surface the reason for fallback as a short code: capacity, latency, model_error, admin_override. Keep UI minimal.
Ava: Telemetry side: emit 'attempted_version' and 'execution_version' per minute with tenant_id. Add 'fallback_reason' when they differ.
Ravi: For quotas, keep billing attribution to the original request route to avoid invoicing surprises, but add an infra counter to track real execution. Show an alert if infra vs billing diverge >5% over 24h.
Tom: Private/Dedicated deployments should default to not showing banners or nudges; only expose the routing preview if admin enables it.
Priya: ops-bot: create a draft incident template for 'deprec-routing-mismatch' to run when divergence spike occurs.
ops-bot: draft incident created: deprec-routing-mismatch-179777-1 assigned to eng-oncall.
Ava: Action items: I'll write a short RFC with metric names and the modal copy. Ravi: please draft the dashboard layout. Tom: spec header 'x-deprec-cohort' and feature flag plan. Priya: mock the modal text for sales-friendly language.\n
